hook.name: AuroraHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a loyalty-based dynamic fee system. Traders accrue a "lumi" score based on time (blocks) elapsed since their last swap, scaled by global trading activity, unlocking lower swap fees (1.00% down to 0.10% across four tiers). Sellers who exit within 24 hours of their last buy pay a 15% impatient tax on ETH output, which is redistributed to registered Stellar-tier Archiver holders.
